about: The Character Builder files the heroine loads, relative to ../Char_B/public. `npm run build` copies ONLY these into dist/charb/. The dev server warns in its terminal when the builder asks for a file that is not listed here (and /__charb-requested lists everything asked for so far): add the path and build again. The FAST heroine (src/heroine/fast/) needs only the body file and her hair's two files (ponytail.glb and ponytail-light.glb; braid.glb and braid-light.glb for the catsuit's Blaze, 2026-11-19: left off this list, she was bald on the phone); the rest are for the Visual body (the builder's hosted room) and the bake page. And models/sarah-skeleton.glb (Joshua, 2026-11-19: her hidden live body complete, the organs placed by her skeleton; left out once while a freeze on his iPhone was tracked down). And models/skins/skin-detail-1024.png (the pore and crease tile of the skin depth hybrid, 2026-11-19: the game draws it on her, fast/skinTexture.ts) with models/skins/sarah-v2-skin-height-2048.png (the builder's own room uses it on her hidden live body). And models/skins/sarah-v2-skin-rough-2048.webp (2026-11-21: her even roughness, which the builder puts on her hidden live body under every skin but ORIGINAL; left off, it logged 'texture not loaded' on every start). And models/male-base.glb (2026-11-21: JOHN's body, 17 MB; left off, v0.2.126 shipped without it and he was quietly left out on Joshua's iPhone). And models/hair/male/crew.glb with crew-light.glb (2026-11-21: JOHN's crew cut, his file of the style for his head, builder v0.9.71).
